brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: Build has 3 full bases (0,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,0,0) plus a half-n base at 1,1,0 creating a drawer site (offer s30 key s at 1,1,0 exists per find_sockets) but no drawer part has been placed; unit is compact (4 bases, ~3 hex footprint)

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform
requirements.evidence: Mount spike placed at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 where three full bases meet (ref spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0); attempt to add platform-sm was refused SPIKE_CLASH 'would foul a piece nearby' both at this junction and alternative junction, so platform is not installed

finish.summary: Build is a compact 3-base cluster with half-base drawer site and mount spike at the requested triple-junction. Both the drawer and the small platform were requested but neither is currently installed - drawer site exists and is ready (s30), platform was refused due to SPIKE_CLASH with adjacent pieces. Mesh clash is clear.
